datasets.use: Regional descriptive context; no clinic hours, waits or forecasting labels

RAG context with exact citations; never automatic clinical authorization
Not imported into agents or treated as verified training data
All rows excluded from numerical conclusions pending original publication/edition and table verification. All source URLs, supplies and demands are absent.
